priorityList: Maintain Cat Form and use Prowl before entering combat.
Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown for Energy and to maintain its damage buff.
Use Rake from Prowl or Shadowmeld to apply an empowered version of the bleed.
Cast Ferocious Bite immediately whenever the Apex Predator's Craving proc makes it free.
Activate Berserk or Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane while Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy when you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Use Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Sync offensive trinkets and combat potions with your Berserk and Tiger's Fury windows.
Use Rip as a finisher at 4 or more Combo Points if the bleed is missing or refreshable.
Cast Ferocious Bite as a finisher at 5 Combo Points (or 4+ during Berserk).
When Berserk is not active, try to pool up to 50 Energy before casting Ferocious Bite for maximum damage.
Maintain the Rake bleed on your target, refreshing it if it has less than 4 seconds remaining.
Maintain Moonfire on the target (if talented) and refresh it when it has less than 4 seconds remaining.
Use Shred as your primary builder to generate Combo Points when all dots are applied.
Use Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs to maintain your rotation's flow.
